code_examples.python_duckdb:
import duckdb
import geopandas as gpd

con = duckdb.connect()
con.execute('INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;')
query = "SELECT * FROM 'https://ide.cit.uai.cl/download/MBHT_2017_Nacional_Manzanas.parquet' LIMIT 1000;"
df = con.execute(query).df()
gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(df, geometry=gpd.GeoSeries.from_wkb(df['geometry']) if 'geometry' in df else None, crs='EPSG:4326')
print(f'Cargados {len(gdf)} registros de MBHT 2017 — Línea base oficial')
code_examples.r_sf_arrow:
library(sf)
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)

# Lectura directa desde GeoParquet
url <- 'https://ide.cit.uai.cl/download/MBHT_2017_Nacional_Manzanas.parquet'
df <- read_parquet(url)
sf_layer <- st_as_sf(df, wkt = 'geometry', crs = 4326)
summary(sf_layer)

code_examples.python_duckdb:
import duckdb
import geopandas as gpd

con = duckdb.connect()
con.execute('INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;')
query = "SELECT * FROM 'https://ide.cit.uai.cl/download/Equipamientos_2017_Nacional_Consolidado.parquet' LIMIT 1000;"
df = con.execute(query).df()
gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(df, geometry=gpd.GeoSeries.from_wkb(df['geometry']) if 'geometry' in df else None, crs='EPSG:4326')
print(f'Cargados {len(gdf)} registros de Equipamientos urbanos y servicios esenciales 2017')

sf_layer <- st_as_sf(df, wkt = 'geometry', crs = 4326)
summary(sf_layer)
